caption: Onboarding offers five models, from Light at 1 credit to Ultra 2K at 3 credits, with 10 free credits. We did not press Generate the try-on because it needs a photo of a person. Sample photos and store name are hidden.
The safety cap defaults to $10 a month, about 250 try-ons on Light. The app says you pay nothing until shoppers use it. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for the usage plan: a spending limit of $10 per 30 days, marked as a test charge on our development store. It went through without a card.
The Playground gives 10 free tests and needs a person photo in step 2. We picked none, so our test has no try-on result to judge. Sample photos and store name are hidden.
Volume tiers cut the price per try-on by 15% from 500 a month up to 50% from 10,000. The Sensitive-content fallback, ticked here, bills a flat $0.08 when it recovers a try-on.
